assumptions: Uncut plasmid runs as its supercoiled, linear and open-circular forms; migration follows SpliceCraft's agarose model.
limits: Band positions, not intensities or smearing.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: One lane's bands as [bp, form] pairs. A gel's reading is over a whole plate and is carried by draw_gel, which runs one; a single lane has no plate to read.
bio.jane/contract.question: Which bands, and in which DNA form, does a ladder, plasmid, digest or PCR lane of this molecule give?

description: Resolve a gel lane (ladder / plasmid / digest / pcr) into [bp, form] bands for the open plasmid.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

detail.description: for a ladder: its name; for a digest: comma-separated enzymes. Unused for plasmid/pcr lanes. Only applies when source is ladder or digest.

product_bp.description: for a pcr lane: the product length, e.g. the length of the record `pcr_amplify` emits. Required for a pcr lane. In bp. Only applies when source is pcr.

source.description: what this lane holds. Values: ladder (DNA ladder), plasmid (Uncut plasmid), digest (Restriction digest), pcr (PCR product).

name: run_gel_lane
